lines.speaker: plant_supervisor
lines.text: The part that bothers me is that nobody owns the decision any more. I don't mean the machine owns it. I mean nobody does.

lines.speaker: plant_supervisor
lines.text: There's a man comes through twice a year, signs for the whole floor, and I could not tell you who he works for. That's who owns it, and he's never in the room when anything gets decided.
